title: Supplier follow-up · Foundation
summary: Handle a missed supplier response without creating noise, losing the decision date or escalating prematurely.
contentNotice: Demonstration learning content for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy, curriculum or language instruction and must be reviewed before operational use.

sections.heading: One clear follow-up is better than repeated chasing

blocks.text: Restate the pending item, the earlier expectation and the date by which MOSCATELLI now needs a response. Then record the next check point instead of sending repeated messages without a decision threshold.

items: A production or sample slot may be lost.
A payment or commercial commitment is approaching.
A launch or internal milestone is now materially at risk.
